evals.prompt: Create an approximately 30-second cinematic Akkari launch film. Focus on capture, prioritize, execute. Music only. Use recognizable icons and visual actions, with little text. I'll export it myself.
evals.expected_output: A live shots.js preview of a launch film: facts.md from inspect/recon, a brief and storyboard in direction.md with purpose, exit and carry per row and three signature moments, built scene by scene and critiqued in rounds logged in critique.md; music/mix guidance as needed. No narration or 3D guidance, no MP4 render, no integration tour. Runtime follows the story.

evals.prompt: Make a narrated kinetic-type announcement for the new search feature. About 20 seconds, short phrases, with a real search-result reveal.
evals.expected_output: A live preview of a kinetic-type film using the narration module: the spoken story is written and recorded before shot timings, and the type is timed to the read in phrases, fully formed, with the real search-result reveal as a visible result. Loads storyboard/build/finish guidance as needed, nothing unrelated. No automatic export.

evals.prompt: The film is good. Just make the music quieter; keep everything else the same.
evals.expected_output: An existing-project audio edit loading only the mix module. Reuses the current bed and picture; no re-planning, screenshots, visual audit, paid review or MP4 render.

evals.prompt: Create a launch film for a product that brings scattered work into one coordinated workspace. You decide the visual direction. Make the animation feel considered and connected.
evals.expected_output: Derives the idea from the product's mechanism (scattered things converging into one workspace) and chooses a carried object the product actually works with, recorded in direction.md with handoff boxes. The storyboard varies scale and layout row to row and every join is made by elements (morph, exit, reflow) and every cut morphs or matches; transformations are staged (hold, clear, transform, settle, reveal) and checked with --times frames around each join. Critique rounds rank problems and fix the biggest first.

evals.prompt: Make a 30-second launch film for our invoicing app. I uploaded uploads/reference.mp4 — I love how the shots flow into each other. Use the numbers from our site.
evals.expected_output: Reads references/reference-video.md before planning: probes the upload, finds its cuts with pitch video analyze, takes an overview contact sheet and dense sheets around its transitions with pitch video frames, and records in direction.md what each key moment does and how it could serve this product, without copying its footage, layout or music. The storyboard carries purpose, exit and carry per row, and the signature moments are named in plain words. On-screen figures come only from facts.md built from the site; nothing invented. Critique checks frame one with --times 0 and the report separates measured items from what still needs a person.

evals.prompt: Generate a motion design video for https://trypitch.co/, the most stunning one you can produce.
evals.expected_output: Narrated, because the brief does not ask for music only: the brief's Sound names the voice, the script is written to audio/vo.txt and recorded with pitch motion tts, then aligned and synced before shot timings, over a bed measured with pitch motion beats. Storyboard rows land on spoken words, each under a picture of what its line says with the key words arriving as spoken. The mix keeps the voice over the bed. No automatic export.
